verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a query-stats view with a searchable stats table and drill-down into a single execution's time breakdown. It also exposes the full stock ClickHouse observability surface, queryable cluster-wide, which together support per-query profiling to diagnose slow queries. Execution-plan inspection (EXPLAIN or plan visualization) is never explicitly documented, so only the profiling half of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit execution-plan/EXPLAIN support, cost or resource attribution per query, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can inspect query profiles and execution plans to find why a query is slow or expensive

citations.quote: the searchable stats table, drilling down to a single execution with its time breakdown, and grouped error signatures.
The full ClickHouse observability surface, unchanged from stock ClickHouse, plus how to query it across the whole cluster at once
